hooks.name: Typecheck, lint and test after code edits
hooks.description: After a TypeScript file is saved, the agent runs typecheck, lint and the related tests (tech steering workflow).

action.prompt: A TypeScript source file was just saved. Before moving to the next task, run `npm run typecheck` and `npm run lint`, and run `npx vitest run` on the test file next to the changed module (or the whole suite if unsure). Fix any error you introduced. If this is a new pure-logic module (validation, presence, nudge, hangout, shortcode, limiter), make sure it has a unit test. Report only failures.
